title: The Book of Esther Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Esther — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)
verses.decoded: It happened during the reign of Ahasuerus, the same Ahasuerus who ruled over one hundred and twenty-seven provinces stretching from India to Ethiopia.

verses.kjv: That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,
verses.decoded: At that time, when King Ahasuerus was sitting on the throne of his kingdom, which was in the palace of Shushan,

verses.kjv: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:
verses.decoded: In the third year of his reign, he held a feast for all his officials and servants; the rulers of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, were present before him:

verses.kjv: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.
verses.decoded: When he displayed the wealth of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty for many days, even one hundred and eighty days.

verses.kjv: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace;
verses.decoded: When these days were over, the king held a feast for all the people present in Shushan the palace, both important and ordinary, lasting seven days, in the courtyard of the garden of the king’s palace.

verses.kjv: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.
verses.decoded: There were white, green, and blue curtains, attached with cords made of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars; the beds were made of gold and silver, placed on a floor made of red, blue, white, and black marble.

verses.kjv: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.
verses.decoded: They served them drinks in gold cups, each cup different from the others, and plenty of royal wine, according to the king's wealth.

verses.kjv: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.
verses.decoded: The drinking followed the law; no one was forced to drink, because the king had commanded all the officers of his palace to act according to each person's desire.

verses.kjv: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.
verses.decoded: Also, Queen Vashti gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace that belonged to King Ahasuerus.

verses.kjv: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, when the king was happy from drinking wine, he ordered Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains who served King Ahasuerus directly,

verses.kjv: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.
verses.decoded: To bring Queen Vashti before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the officials her beauty, because she was beautiful to look at.

verses.kjv: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
verses.decoded: But Queen Vashti refused to come when the king ordered her through his attendants; so the king was very angry, and his anger burned inside him.

verses.kjv: Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king’s manner toward all that knew law and judgment:
verses.decoded: Then the king said to the wise men who understood the times, (for this was the king’s custom toward all who knew the law and could judge):

verses.kjv: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king’s face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)
verses.decoded: Next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

verses.kjv: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?
verses.decoded: What should we do to Queen Vashti according to the law, because she has not obeyed King Ahasuerus' command given through the chamberlains?

verses.kjv: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.
verses.decoded: And Memucan answered in front of the king and the princes, saying, Queen Vashti has not wronged only the king, but also all the princes and all the people in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus.

verses.kjv: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.
verses.decoded: This action of the queen will become known to all women, and they will look down on their husbands when they hear that King Ahasuerus commanded Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she did not come.

verses.kjv: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king’s princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath.
verses.decoded: In the same way, the women of Persia and Media will say today to all the king’s princes who have heard about what the queen did. This will cause a lot of disrespect and anger.

verses.kjv: If it please the king, let there go a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.
verses.decoded: If the king agrees, let a royal decree be issued by him, and let it be written in the laws of the Persians and the Medes so that it cannot be changed, that Vashti will no longer come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal position to someone better than her.

verses.kjv: And when the king’s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.
verses.decoded: And when the king's decree that he will make is announced throughout his entire empire, because it is very large, all the wives will respect their husbands, whether they are important or not.

verses.kjv: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:
verses.decoded: The proposal pleased the king and the princes, and the king acted according to Memucan's advice.

verses.kjv: For he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people.
verses.decoded: Because he sent letters to all the king’s provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their own language, so that every man would be the ruler in his own household, and so that it would be announced in the language of every people.

verses.kjv: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
verses.decoded: After these events, when King Ahasuerus's anger had calmed down, he thought about Vashti, what she had done, and the punishment that had been decided for her.

verses.kjv: Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:
verses.decoded: Then the king’s servants who served him said, Let beautiful young virgins be searched for the king:

verses.kjv: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hege the king’s chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given them:
verses.decoded: And let the king appoint officials in all the provinces of his kingdom to bring together all the beautiful young virgins to Shushan the palace, to the house of the women under the care of Hegai, the king’s chamberlain, who is in charge of the women; and let their purification supplies be given to them.

verses.kjv: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.
verses.decoded: Let the young woman who pleases the king become queen instead of Vashti. The king liked this idea, so he did it.

verses.kjv: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;
verses.decoded: At the palace in Shushan, there was a Jewish man named Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin;

verses.kjv: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.
verses.decoded: They had been taken away from Jerusalem during the exile that happened when Jeconiah, king of Judah, was taken captive by Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.
verses.decoded: He raised Hadassah, who is Esther, his uncle’s daughter, because she had no father or mother. The young woman was beautiful and lovely. Mordecai took her as his own daughter after her parents died.

verses.kjv: So it came to pass, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the king’s command and his decree were heard, and many young women were gathered together at Shushan the palace, under the care of Hegai, Esther was also brought to the king’s house, under the care of Hegai, the keeper of the women.

verses.kjv: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king’s house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.
verses.decoded: The young woman pleased him, and she received favor from him; he quickly gave her her items for purification, along with her own belongings, and seven young women who were suitable to be given to her from the king’s palace. He assigned her and her attendants to the best place in the women’s quarters.

verses.kjv: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.
verses.decoded: Esther had not revealed her people or her family, because Mordecai had instructed her not to reveal it.

verses.kjv: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women’s house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.
verses.decoded: And Mordecai walked every day in front of the courtyard of the women's house to find out how Esther was doing and what would happen to her.

verses.kjv: Now when every maid’s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)
verses.decoded: Now when each young woman’s turn came to go to King Ahasuerus, after she had spent twelve months, according to the custom for the women, (for this was the time required for their purification, that is, six months with myrrh oil, and six months with perfumes and other things used for the purification of the women;)

verses.kjv: Then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king’s house.
verses.decoded: Then each young woman went to the king; whatever she wanted was given to her to take with her from the women's quarters to the king's palace.

verses.kjv: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.
verses.decoded: In the evening she left, and the next day she returned to the second house of the women, under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s chamberlain, who was in charge of the concubines. She did not go to the king again unless the king was pleased with her and called her by name.

verses.kjv: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.
verses.decoded: When it was Esther's turn, the daughter of Abihail, the uncle of Mordecai who had adopted her as his daughter, to go to the king, she asked for nothing except what Hegai, the king’s chamberlain and the official in charge of the women, provided. Esther gained favor in the eyes of everyone who saw her.

verses.kjv: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
verses.decoded: So Esther was brought to King Ahasuerus into his royal palace in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

verses.kjv: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verses.decoded: The king loved Esther more than all the other women, and she found kindness and approval in his eyes more than all the young women; so he placed the royal crown on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.

verses.kjv: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.
verses.decoded: Then the king held a large banquet for all his officials and servants, even Esther’s banquet; and he issued a pardon to the provinces and gave gifts, in keeping with the king’s generosity.

verses.kjv: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king’s gate.
verses.decoded: And when the young women were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate.

verses.kjv: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.
verses.decoded: Esther had not yet revealed her family or her people, just as Mordecai had instructed her; because Esther obeyed Mordecai's command, just as she was raised with him.

verses.kjv: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king’s gate, two of the king’s chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
verses.decoded: At that time, while Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, two of the king’s chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, who were responsible for guarding the door, became angry and planned to attack King Ahasuerus.

verses.kjv: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai’s name.
verses.decoded: The matter became known to Mordecai, who told Queen Esther about it; and Esther reported it to the king in Mordecai’s name.

verses.kjv: And when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.
verses.decoded: And when an investigation was made about the matter, it was discovered; so they were both hanged on a tree, and it was recorded in the book of the chronicles in front of the king.

verses.kjv: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.
verses.decoded: After these events, King Ahasuerus promoted Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and gave him a higher position, placing him above all the other princes who were with him.

verses.kjv: And all the king’s servants, that were in the king’s gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.
verses.decoded: All the king’s servants who were at the king’s gate bowed down and showed respect to Haman because the king had commanded them to do so. But Mordecai did not bow down or show respect to him.

verses.kjv: Then the king’s servants, which were in the king’s gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king’s commandment?
verses.decoded: Then the king’s servants, who were at the king’s gate, said to Mordecai, Why are you disobeying the king’s command?

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.
verses.decoded: It happened that when they spoke to him every day and he did not listen to them, they reported to Haman to find out if Mordecai's situation would hold up, because Mordecai had told them that he was a Jew.

verses.kjv: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.
verses.decoded: When Haman saw that Mordecai did not bow down or show him respect, Haman became very angry.

verses.kjv: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.
verses.decoded: And he considered it disgraceful to attack only Mordecai; because they had told him about Mordecai's people. Therefore, Haman planned to destroy all the Jews throughout the entire kingdom of Ahasuerus, including Mordecai's people.

verses.kjv: In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.
verses.decoded: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, which means the lot, in front of Haman day after day and month after month until the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

verses.kjv: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king’s laws: therefore it is not for the king’s profit to suffer them.
verses.decoded: And Haman said to King Ahasuerus, There is a certain group of people scattered and spread out among the people in all the provinces of your kingdom; and their laws are different from all other people; they do not follow the king’s laws: therefore it is not beneficial for the king to allow them to continue.

verses.kjv: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.
verses.decoded: If the king agrees, let a decree be written so that they can be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the officials in charge to deposit into the king’s treasury.

verses.kjv: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.
verses.decoded: And the king took his ring from his hand and gave it to Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Haman, The silver is given to you, and the people as well, to do with them as you think best.

verses.kjv: Then were the king’s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king’s ring.
verses.decoded: Then the king’s scribes were called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and a document was written according to all that Haman had commanded to the king’s officials, to the governors over every province, and to the rulers of every people in every province according to their own writing, and to every people in their own language; it was written in the name of King Ahasuerus and sealed with the king’s ring.

verses.kjv: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.
verses.decoded: And the letters were sent by couriers to all the king’s provinces, to destroy, kill, and wipe out all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, on one day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take their possessions as plunder.

verses.kjv: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.
verses.decoded: A copy of the decree to be issued in every province was sent out to all the people, so they would be prepared for that day.

verses.kjv: The posts went out, being hastened by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.
verses.decoded: The messengers went out quickly because the king ordered it, and the decree was announced in the palace of Shushan. The king and Haman sat down to drink, but the people of the city of Shushan were confused.

verses.kjv: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;
verses.decoded: When Mordecai understood everything that had happened, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and ashes, went out into the middle of the city, and shouted loudly with a bitter cry;

verses.kjv: And came even before the king’s gate: for none might enter into the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.
verses.decoded: And they came right up to the king’s gate, because no one was allowed to enter the king’s gate wearing sackcloth.

verses.kjv: And in every province, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.decoded: And in every province, wherever the king’s command and his decree arrived, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting, crying, and loud lamenting; and many wore sackcloth and ashes.

verses.kjv: So Esther’s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.
verses.decoded: So Esther’s female servants and her attendants came and told her. Then the queen was very upset; and she sent clothes to dress Mordecai and to remove his sackcloth from him, but he did not accept them.

verses.kjv: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king’s chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.
verses.decoded: Then Esther called for Hatach, one of the king’s chamberlains, whom the king had assigned to serve her, and gave him a message to take to Mordecai, asking what it was and why it was.

verses.kjv: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king’s gate.
verses.decoded: So Hatach went out to Mordecai at the street of the city, which was in front of the king’s gate.

verses.kjv: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.
verses.decoded: And Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him, and about the amount of money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasury to destroy the Jews.

verses.kjv: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.
verses.decoded: He also gave him a copy of the written decree that was issued in Shushan to destroy them, to show it to Esther, to explain it to her, and to command her to go to the king to plead with him and to ask him on behalf of her people.

verses.kjv: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
verses.decoded: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

verses.kjv: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;
verses.decoded: Again Esther spoke to Hatach and gave him a message to take to Mordecai;

verses.kjv: All the king’s servants, and the people of the king’s provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
verses.decoded: All the king’s servants and the people in the king’s provinces know that anyone, whether man or woman, who comes to the king into the inner court without being invited will be put to death according to the king’s law, unless the king extends the golden scepter to them so they may live. But I have not been invited to come to the king for these thirty days.

verses.kjv: And they told to Mordecai Esther’s words.
verses.decoded: They reported Esther’s words to Mordecai.

verses.kjv: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king’s house, more than all the Jews.
verses.decoded: Then Mordecai instructed Esther to answer, Do not think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house more than all the Jews.

verses.kjv: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
verses.decoded: For if you completely remain silent at this time, then relief and rescue for the Jews will come from another place; but you and your father's family will be destroyed. And who knows if you have come to the kingdom for a time like this?

verses.kjv: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer,
verses.decoded: Then Esther told them to give Mordecai this answer,

verses.kjv: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
verses.decoded: Go, gather all the Jews who are in Shushan, and fast for me, not eating or drinking for three days and nights. I and my servants will fast the same way. Then I will go to the king, even though it is against the law. If I die, I die.

verses.kjv: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
verses.decoded: So Mordecai went on his way and did everything that Esther had told him to do.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, over against the king’s house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.
verses.decoded: On the third day, Esther put on her royal clothes and stood in the inner courtyard of the king’s palace, facing the king’s palace. The king was sitting on his royal throne in the palace, facing the palace gate.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.
verses.decoded: When the king saw Queen Esther standing in the court, she found favor in his eyes. The king held out the golden scepter that was in his hand to Esther. Esther approached and touched the tip of the scepter.

verses.kjv: Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.
verses.decoded: Then the king said to her, What do you want, Queen Esther? And what is your request? It will be given to you, even up to half of the kingdom.

verses.kjv: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.
verses.decoded: And Esther answered, If the king agrees, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.

verses.kjv: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.
verses.decoded: Then the king said, Make Haman hurry so that he can do what Esther has said. So the king and Haman went to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Esther at the wine banquet, What is your request? It will be granted to you. And what is your demand? Even if it is half of the kingdom, it will be done for you.

verses.kjv: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;
verses.decoded: Then Esther answered and said, My petition and my request is;

verses.kjv: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.
verses.decoded: If I have found favor in the eyes of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my request and fulfill my petition, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.

verses.kjv: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
verses.decoded: Then Haman left that day happy and with a joyful heart; but when Haman saw Mordecai at the king’s gate, that he did not stand up or move for him, he became very angry with Mordecai.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.
verses.decoded: However, Haman controlled himself; and when he came home, he sent for his friends and his wife Zeresh.

verses.kjv: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.
verses.decoded: And Haman told them about the greatness of his wealth, the number of his children, all the ways the king had promoted him, and how the king had raised him above the princes and servants.

verses.kjv: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.
verses.decoded: Haman said furthermore, Yes, Queen Esther did not allow anyone to come with the king to the banquet she prepared except me; and tomorrow I am also invited to her banquet with the king.

verses.kjv: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.
verses.decoded: Yet all of this means nothing to me as long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.

verses.kjv: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.
verses.decoded: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, "Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and tomorrow speak to the king so that Mordecai may be hanged on it; then go happily with the king to the banquet." This plan pleased Haman, and he had the gallows made.

verses.kjv: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
verses.decoded: That night the king could not sleep, so he ordered the book of records and chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

verses.kjv: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
verses.decoded: It was discovered written down that Mordecai had reported Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's officers who guarded the entrance, who planned to attack King Ahasuerus.

verses.kjv: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.
verses.decoded: And the king said, What honor and respect have been given to Mordecai for this? Then the king’s servants who served him said, Nothing has been done for him.

verses.kjv: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king’s house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.
verses.decoded: And the king said, Who is in the courtyard? At that moment, Haman had come into the outer courtyard of the king’s palace to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows he had prepared for him.

verses.kjv: And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.
verses.decoded: The king’s servants said to him, Look, Haman is standing in the courtyard. And the king said, Let him come in.

verses.kjv: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?
verses.decoded: So Haman came in. And the king said to him, What should be done for the man whom the king wants to honor? Now Haman thought to himself, Who would the king want to honor more than me?

verses.kjv: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,
verses.decoded: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king wants to honor,

verses.kjv: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:
verses.decoded: Bring the royal clothes that the king wears, the horse that the king rides, and the royal crown that is on his head.

verses.kjv: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
verses.decoded: And let this clothing and horse be given to one of the king’s most noble princes, so that they can dress the man whom the king wants to honor, and bring him on horseback through the city street, announcing before him, This is how the man whom the king wants to honor will be treated.

verses.kjv: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king’s gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.
verses.decoded: Then the king said to Haman, Hurry and take the clothes and the horse, just as you said, and do exactly the same for Mordecai the Jew who sits at the king’s gate; do not leave out anything you have mentioned.

verses.kjv: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
verses.decoded: Then Haman took the clothes and the horse, dressed Mordecai, and led him on horseback through the city streets, announcing in front of him, "This is what will be done for the man the king wants to honor."

verses.kjv: And Mordecai came again to the king’s gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.
verses.decoded: And Mordecai returned again to the king’s gate. But Haman hurried to his house, grieving and with his head covered.

verses.kjv: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.
verses.decoded: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, If Mordecai is from the Jewish people, before whom you have already started to fall, you will not succeed against him, but you will certainly fall before him.

verses.kjv: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king’s chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.
verses.decoded: While they were still talking with him, the king’s chamberlains arrived and quickly brought Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

verses.kjv: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
verses.decoded: Then the king and Haman came to have a meal with Queen Esther.

verses.kjv: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.
verses.decoded: And the king said again to Esther on the second day at the wine banquet, What is your request, Queen Esther? It will be granted to you. And what is your demand? It will be done, even if it is half of the kingdom.

verses.kjv: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:
verses.decoded: Then Queen Esther answered and said, If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given to me at my request, and my people at my petition:

verses.kjv: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king’s damage.
verses.decoded: Because my people and I have been sold to be destroyed, killed, and wiped out. But if we had been sold as slaves and slave women, I would have kept silent, even though the enemy could not make up for the king’s loss.

verses.kjv: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?
verses.decoded: Then King Ahasuerus answered and said to Queen Esther, Who is he, and where is he, who dared to think in his heart to do this?

verses.kjv: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
verses.decoded: And Esther said, The opponent and enemy is this evil Haman. Then Haman was afraid in front of the king and the queen.

verses.kjv: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
verses.decoded: And the king got up from the wine banquet in his anger and went into the palace garden; and Haman stood up to plead for his life to Queen Esther because he realized that the king had decided to do evil to him.

verses.kjv: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.
verses.decoded: Then the king came back from the palace garden into the banquet hall where the wine was served; and Haman had fallen onto the couch where Esther was lying. Then the king said, "Will he also force the queen in front of me in the palace?" As soon as the king said this, they covered Haman’s face.

verses.kjv: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
verses.decoded: And Harbonah, one of the king's attendants, said in front of the king, Look, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman made for Mordecai, who had spoken well for the king, is standing in Haman's house. Then the king said, Hang him on it.

verses.kjv: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.
verses.decoded: So they hung Haman on the gallows that he had made for Mordecai. Then the king’s anger was calmed.

verses.kjv: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews’ enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.
verses.decoded: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the enemy of the Jews, to Queen Esther. And Mordecai came before the king because Esther had explained who he was to her.

verses.kjv: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
verses.decoded: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther put Mordecai in charge of Haman's house.

verses.kjv: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.
verses.decoded: And Esther spoke again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and begged him with tears to remove the evil plan of Haman the Agagite, and the scheme that he had planned against the Jews.

verses.kjv: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,
verses.decoded: Then the king extended the golden scepter toward Esther. So Esther got up and stood in front of the king,

verses.kjv: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king’s provinces:
verses.decoded: And said, If the king agrees, and if I have found favor in his eyes, and if it seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his sight, let it be written to cancel the letters created by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews in all the king’s provinces:

verses.kjv: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?
verses.decoded: How can I bear to see the harm that will come to my people? How can I bear to see the destruction of my relatives?

verses.kjv: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.
verses.decoded: Then King Ahasuerus said to Queen Esther and to Mordecai the Jew, Look, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he attacked the Jews.

verses.kjv: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring: for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may no man reverse.
verses.decoded: Write also for the Jews whatever you want, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring, because the document written in the king’s name and sealed with the king’s ring cannot be canceled by anyone.

verses.kjv: Then were the king’s scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.
verses.decoded: At that time, the king’s scribes were called in the third month, which is the month of Sivan, on the twenty-third day. They wrote everything exactly as Mordecai commanded, sending it to the Jews, as well as to the lieutenants, deputies, and rulers of the provinces from India to Ethiopia—127 provinces in total. Each province received the letter written in its own script, to every people in their own language, and to the Jews in their own script and language.

verses.kjv: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus’ name, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:
verses.decoded: He wrote the letters in the name of King Ahasuerus, sealed them with the king’s ring, and sent them by couriers on horses, mules, camels, and young dromedaries.

verses.kjv: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,
verses.decoded: In this decree, the king allowed the Jews in every city to assemble and defend their lives by destroying, killing, and completely defeating any group of people or province that attacked them, including children and women, and to take their possessions as plunder.

verses.kjv: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
verses.decoded: On one day throughout all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, specifically on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar.

verses.kjv: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
verses.decoded: The copy of the decree to be issued in every province was announced to all the people, so that the Jews would be prepared on that day to defend themselves against their enemies.

verses.kjv: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.
verses.decoded: So the messengers who rode on mules and camels went out quickly, urged on by the king’s command. And the decree was issued at the palace in Shushan.

verses.kjv: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
verses.decoded: And Mordecai left the king's presence wearing royal clothes of blue and white, with a large gold crown, and a garment made of fine linen and purple; and the city of Shushan was joyful and happy.

verses.kjv: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
verses.decoded: The Jews experienced happiness, celebration, joy, and respect.

verses.kjv: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.
verses.decoded: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s command and his decree arrived, the Jews experienced joy and happiness, celebrating with feasts and special days. Many people of the land became Jews because they were afraid of the Jews.

verses.kjv: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king’s commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)
verses.decoded: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar, on the thirteenth day of that month, when the king’s command and his decree were about to be carried out, on the day when the enemies of the Jews expected to have power over them, (but it was the opposite, because the Jews had power over those who hated them;)

verses.kjv: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.
verses.decoded: The Jews gathered together in their cities throughout all the provinces of King Ahasuerus to attack those who wanted to harm them, and no one could resist them because everyone was afraid of them.

verses.kjv: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.
verses.decoded: All the governors of the provinces, the commanders, the deputies, and the king's officers helped the Jews because they were afraid of Mordecai.

verses.kjv: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
verses.decoded: Mordecai was important in the king’s palace, and his reputation spread throughout all the provinces because Mordecai became more and more powerful.

verses.kjv: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.
verses.decoded: So the Jews killed all their enemies with the sword, slaughter, and destruction, and did whatever they wanted to those who hated them.

verses.kjv: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.
verses.decoded: And in Shushan the palace, the Jews killed and completely destroyed five hundred men.

verses.kjv: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,
verses.decoded: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

verses.kjv: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,
verses.decoded: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

verses.kjv: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,
verses.decoded: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

verses.kjv: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
verses.decoded: They killed the ten sons of Haman, the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews; but they did not take any of the plunder.

verses.kjv: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.
verses.decoded: On that day, the number of people who were killed in Shushan the palace was reported to the king.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Queen Esther, The Jews have killed and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? Now, what is your petition? It will be granted to you. Or what is your further request? It will be done.

verses.kjv: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.
verses.decoded: Then Esther said, If the king agrees, let the Jews who are in Shushan be allowed to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.
verses.decoded: And the king ordered it to be done that way, and the decree was issued at Shushan; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

verses.kjv: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.
verses.decoded: The Jews who were in Shushan also gathered together on the fourteenth day of the month Adar and killed three hundred men in Shushan, but they did not take any plunder.

verses.kjv: But the other Jews that were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,
verses.decoded: But the other Jews who were in the king's provinces gathered together, defended themselves, found safety from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of their enemies, but they did not take any of the plunder.

verses.kjv: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
verses.decoded: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they rested and made it a day of celebration and joy.

verses.kjv: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
verses.decoded: But the Jews who were in Shushan gathered together on the thirteenth day of that month; and on the fourteenth day; and on the fifteenth day of the same month they rested, and made it a day of celebration and joy.

verses.kjv: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.
verses.decoded: So the Jews living in the villages in the towns without walls made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of joy and celebration, a good day, and a day for sending gifts to each other.

verses.kjv: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
verses.decoded: And Mordecai wrote these things and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

verses.kjv: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,
verses.decoded: To establish this among them, that they should observe the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same month, every year,

verses.kjv: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
verses.decoded: As the days when the Jews were free from their enemies, and the month that changed for them from sadness to happiness, and from mourning to a joyful day: they should make these days times of celebration and happiness, and send food to each other, and give gifts to the poor.

verses.kjv: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;
verses.decoded: And the Jews committed to doing what they had started, just as Mordecai had written to them;

verses.kjv: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;
verses.decoded: Because Haman, the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, who was the enemy of all the Jews, had planned against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, which means the lot, to decide when to consume and destroy them;

verses.kjv: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
verses.decoded: But when Esther approached the king, he ordered by written decree that the evil plan he made against the Jews would come back on him, and that he and his sons would be hanged on the gallows.

verses.kjv: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,
verses.decoded: Therefore, they called these days Purim, after the name Pur. So, because of all the words in this letter, and what they had seen about this matter, and what had come to them,

verses.kjv: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;
verses.decoded: The Jews established and committed themselves, and their descendants, and all who joined with them, to make sure that these two days would be observed according to their records and at the appointed time every year;

verses.kjv: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.
verses.decoded: And that these days should be remembered and observed by every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should never disappear among the Jews, nor should their memory be lost from their descendants.

verses.kjv: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
verses.decoded: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with full authority to confirm this second letter about Purim.

verses.kjv: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,
verses.decoded: And he sent letters to all the Jews in the 127 provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with messages of peace and truth,

verses.kjv: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
verses.decoded: To establish these days of Purim at their appointed times, just as Mordecai the Jew and Queen Esther had commanded them, and as they had decided for themselves and their descendants, concerning the fasting and their prayers.

verses.kjv: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
verses.decoded: And Esther's decree confirmed these things about Purim; and it was recorded in the book.

verses.kjv: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
verses.decoded: King Ahasuerus imposed a tax on the land and on the islands of the sea.

verses.kjv: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
verses.decoded: All the acts of his power and strength, and the account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king promoted him, are they not written in the book of the records of the kings of Media and Persia?

verses.kjv: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
verses.decoded: Because Mordecai the Jew was second in rank to King Ahasuerus, was respected among the Jews, and was accepted by many of his fellow Jews, working to improve the welfare of his people and promoting peace among all his descendants.
